name: Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back
review: An absolute masterpiece from my childhood! Mewtwo's philosophical monologue at the end still gives me chills every single time.

name: Pokémon: Detective Pikachu
review: Ryan Reynolds brings Pikachu to life brilliantly. The live-action worldbuilding of Ryme City felt like a dream come true for longtime fans.

name: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
review: Hands down one of the best Pokémon movie storylines ever written. Lucario's noble sacrifice and bond with Sir Aaron is deeply moving.

name: Pokémon: Indigo League
review: Where it all began! The humor, Ash's raw starter journey with Pikachu, and iconic Gym battles make this season unmatched nostalgia.

name: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
review: A refreshing new direction for the franchise with Liko and Roy. The animation quality, pacing, and character dynamics are fantastic.
